'''Wolfgang Hahn''' (April 30, 1911 – January 10, 1998) was a German [[mathematician]] who worked on [[special functions]], in particular [[orthogonal polynomials]].

He introduced [[Hahn polynomials]], Hahn difference, Hahn q-addition (or [[F. H. Jackson| Jackson]]-Hahn-Cigler q-addition), and the [[Hahn–Exton q-Bessel function]]. He was an honorary member of the [[Austrian Mathematical Society]].
